summary: First full E2E test of Crystal Meets. Backend: 31 pytest cases across meets listing/filters, single meet 404, register/login/me/logout, Google session error paths, admin-only CRUD (401/403/404/422), saved meets, share OG HTML, weather fallback — all 31 PASSED. Frontend: intro animation, desktop three-zone layout, filters (category/family/weekend/featured/clear), hover->pin highlight, card & pin-popup & featured-strip navigation, meet detail (live status, weather chip 'Unavailable', Google/Apple Maps hrefs, share->clipboard), auth modal (login + register), save meet, admin dashboard full CRUD (create/edit/delete verified in UI), role gating (anon 'Admin Access', user 'Admin only'), Simple View + localStorage persistence — all working. Two significant UI defects found: mobile map has zero height (blank screen) and desktop Filters popover renders behind the Leaflet map.

minor.issue: Returns {label: 'Unavailable'} (Open-Meteo rate-limited from shared IP). Endpoint responds 200 with graceful fallback — accepted per instructions, not a bug.
No brute-force lockout / rate limiting: unlimited wrong-password attempts are accepted (only 401 each time).

ui_bugs.issue: On mobile (390px) the map container resolves to height 0 -> the whole map area is blank black (no tiles, no pins visible), only featured strip + 'View Meets List' button render. Measured: meet-map bounding box {w:390,h:0}, leaflet-container {w:390,h:0}. RCA: <div className='md:hidden flex-1 relative'> collapses because ancestors lack min-h-0/explicit height while MeetMap uses h-full. Fix: give the mobile wrapper an explicit height (e.g. h-[calc(100vh-3.5rem-Xpx)]) or add min-h-0 + flex-1 chain.

Filters dropdown is painted UNDER the Leaflet map: only the top ~150px (title + first chip row) is visible, the rest of the 478px-tall panel is hidden behind the map even though it is hit-testable. RCA: Radix PopoverContent wrapper z-index 50 vs leaflet pane z-index 400/800 (.leaflet-map-pane=400). Fix: add z-[1000] to PopoverContent (and DropdownMenuContent) or set .leaflet-pane{z-index:auto} / isolate the map container.

Duplicate data-testids: desktop and mobile branches both mount (hidden only by CSS) -> 2x [data-testid=meet-map] (two live Leaflet instances, duplicate tile requests) and 24x meet-card-<id> for 12 meets; weather-overlay renders twice on the detail page. Makes strict selectors ambiguous and wastes resources.
Console error: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible for screen reader users' when opening the mobile list drawer / filters sheet.

issues: admin-date uses the browser-native datetime-local picker instead of the shadcn calendar/date component
Every anonymous page load logs two 401 console errors from GET /api/auth/me — consider suppressing/expected-handling since auth is optional site-wide

action_items: Fix mobile map height (Discover.jsx mobile branch) — map is completely invisible on phones.
Raise z-index of Radix Popover/Dropdown content above Leaflet panes so the desktop Filters panel is fully visible.
Avoid mounting both desktop and mobile layouts simultaneously (or make testids unique) to remove duplicate meet-map/meet-card/weather-overlay nodes and the second Leaflet instance.
Add DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden title) to mobile Drawer/Sheet contents for a11y.
Consider login rate-limiting/lockout after repeated failed attempts.
critical_code_review_comments: Discover.jsx renders MeetMap and MeetList twice (desktop + mobile branches) — two Leaflet map instances stay alive; use a breakpoint hook to render one.
server.py update_meet filters out None values, so a client can never clear an optional field (e.g. set image_url/organiser back to null); use model_dump(exclude_unset=True) instead.
No enum validation for MeetIn.category/status — arbitrary strings are accepted by POST/PUT /api/meets; use Literal/Enum.
server.py uses blocking `requests` inside async endpoints (/api/weather, /api/auth/google/session) which blocks the event loop; switch to httpx.AsyncClient.
Login endpoint has no attempt throttling; password policy is unenforced on /api/auth/register (any length accepted).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (run: pytest /app/backend/tests -v). Category filter testids are lowercase (cat-jdm, cat-german ...), not cat-JDM. filters-close only exists in the mobile sheet; the desktop popover closes on outside click. Weather correctly returns 'Unavailable'. Re-verify: (1) mobile map height at 390px, (2) desktop Filters popover fully visible over the map, (3) duplicate meet-map/meet-card testids removed.
rca_of_the_issue: Mobile blank map: flex-1 wrapper in Discover.jsx has no resolved height so MeetMap's h-full computes to 0 (verified via getBoundingClientRect -> h:0). Filters panel hidden: Radix popover portal has z-index 50 while Leaflet's .leaflet-map-pane is z-index 400, so the map paints over the panel while the panel still receives pointer events (clicks worked, hence filtering logic is correct).
